thread:
ivy (People Ops): Quick pilot idea: install a 'Kudos Vend' tabletop machine in SF and NYC lobbies for 4 weeks. Employees can redeem a token to drop a micro-spot award into someone else's account. Need vendor quote, power/footprint ok, QR/scan flow, and one volunteer per day to refill. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

chao (Facilities): Footprint: 18x12x12, needs a standard outlet and 2ft table. Lobby managers need 48hr notice. We can host both locations.

mina (Finance): Budget? hardware rental + refill packs + shipping. Approve up to $1,000 pilot from culture fund pending vendor invoice and tax ID. Code to GL 4-215.

owen (EngOps): QR flow: scan -> small web form -> sends token to People Ops for redemption. I can build a tiny lambda + webhook if we get ok. Rate limits low.

hana (Design): I'll do vinyl art for the machines and a short instructional postcard. Also mockups by Tue.

ivy (People Ops): Refill plan: each pack = 50 tokens; estimate 60 redemptions/week/location. Need two refill packs per week per site. Volunteers to restock Mon & Thu mornings. Who can help SF week of May 24? @here

chao (Facilities): I'll coordinate lobby notices and storage. Recommend lockbox for overnight storage.

mina (Finance): Please upload vendor quote + W-9 to the sheet so I can PO. Also add a line on internal packing slip: "GL 4-215; retain receipts."

owen (EngOps): For security we should rate-limit to 5 requests/min and log IPs. I'll prototype the lambda and DM steps.

kudos-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Draft QR flow + vendor quotes by Tue". :robot_face:

ivy (People Ops): Final ask: volunteer roster for SF on May 24 (refill 9am) and NYC May 26. I'll update sheet with vendor links and sign-up. Excited to try a playful nudge to recognition :)
